rites.name: Amiallosia
rites.text: Amiallosia is a concept of the Draggouzhok Courts, the principle that a trial must be witnessed by a council before it can be sealed into a door between worlds. In the Age of the first sovereign it was the quiet discipline that let groves grow into kingdoms without the trials turning into wars.

rites.name: Kalutanira
rites.text: Kalutanira is the concept of the Weave as it was first pressed into the ground during the Seeding, when the makers sowed quiet powers that would sleep until the Holy Age. It names the moment a temple's flame first held a thread of that sleeping force, a quiet bond between hearth and hidden current. Its strength lies in patience, not in sudden blows.

rites.name: Venuallae
rites.text: Venuallae is a concept in the Martial Realm of Draggouzhok, born during the Fall and the Sundering when the Shards broke away from one another. It is remembered as the discipline of the Holy Age's temple orders, the flame-bound forms sworn into the Pact.

rites.name: Suramaroma
rites.text: Suramaroma is the concept of a great walled bulwark that holds back the tides of the Draggouzhok realm, recorded in the Walled Age as the first thing the orders learned to name. Its sacred wardings were said to outlast whole generations of siege and rain. Its earliest keepers counted their first crossings of the outer moat as the start of the record.
